words: a car parked in the ego's lane on a two-way road of one lane each way, with oncoming cars 40 m apart at 40 km/h (CARLA ParkedObstacleTwoWays, SUMO Town01 site 0), and the ego stopped behind it at t 13.5 and waited until the run ended at t 260: it never passed through the oncoming lane in a gap. The same at all four sites (Town01 0 and 1, Town02 0 and 1). No rule of the family lends the opposite lane for a pass, so this card was expected to fail (the gap card).
